exposure: Domestic violence one year before pregnancy
cohort: 960 literate pregnant women attending four primary health-care centers in Muscat from April 1, 2019 to March 31, 2020
finding: While domestic violence rates were lower during pregnancy and the year prior compared to lifelong prevalence, a strong association was found between physical domestic violence before pregnancy and unplanned pregnancy, and domestic violence was linked to depression, insomnia, and somatic symptoms.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between domestic violence and mode of delivery.
